Ah, that is she!--the figure of the expected one; and a little girl of some eleven years is helped carefully out by Mr.

76305-the-catholic-church-and-conversion.title: And Conversion
76305-the-catholic-church-and-conversion.creator: G. K. Chesterton
76305-the-catholic-church-and-conversion.description: A book by G. K. Chesterton. than it is for one who has had the advantage of the Faith from childhood. There is at once a sort of impertinence in approaching an experience other than one’s own (necessarily more imperfectly grasped), and an ignorance of the matter. Those born into the Faith very often go through an experience of their own parallel to, and in some way resembling, that experience whereby original strangers to the Faith come to see it and to accept it.

arxiv-2011-11628.description: Abstract . In short geometrization conjecture of W. Thurston (finally proved by G. Perelman) says that any oriented 3 3 -manifold can be canonically partitioned into pieces, which have a geometric structure of one of the eight types. In the seminal paper (1991) M. W. Davis and T.

arxiv-2012-01716.title: Rainbow triangles in edge-colored complete graphs
arxiv-2012-01716.creator: Xiaozheng Chen, Xueliang Li
arxiv-2012-01716.description: Abstract Let G G be a graph of order n n with an edge-coloring c c , and let δ c ​ ( G ) \delta^{c}(G) denote the minimum color-degree of G G . A subgraph F F of G G is called rainbow if any two edges of F F have distinct colors.

arxiv-2012-09914.title: Impact of cladding elements on the loss performance of hollow-core anti-resonant fibers Journal: osac Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2012-09914.creator: Md. Selim Habib, \authormark 1,* Christos Markos, \authormark 2 and Rodrigo Amezcua-Correa \authormark 3
arxiv-2012-09914.description: Abstract Understanding the impact of the cladding tube structure on the overall guiding performance is crucial for designing single-mode, wide-band, and ultra low-loss nested hollow-core anti-resonant fiber (HC-ARF). Here we thoroughly investigate on how the propagation loss is affected by the nested elements when their geometry is realistic ( i.e., non-ideal).

arxiv-2103-06264.title: A Lattice Linear Predicate Parallel Algorithm for the Dynamic Programming Problems
arxiv-2103-06264.creator: Vijay K. Garg
arxiv-2103-06264.description: Abstract It has been shown that the parallel Lattice Linear Predicate (LLP) algorithm solves many combinatorial optimization problems such as the shortest path problem, the stable marriage problem and the market clearing price problem. In this paper, we give the parallel LLP algorithm for many dynamic programming problems.

arxiv-2103-12795.title: Behavior rigidity near non-isolated blow-up points for the semilinear heat equation
arxiv-2103-12795.creator: Frank Merle
arxiv-2103-12795.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Frank Merle. We consider the semilinear heat equation with Sobolev subcritical power nonlinearity in dimension N = 2 N=2 , and u ⁡ ( x , t ) u(x,t) a solution which blows up in finite time T T . Given a non isolated blow-up point a a , we assume that the Taylor expansion of the solution near ( a , T ) (a,T) obeys some degenerate situation labeled by some even integer m ⁡ ( a ) ≥ 4 m(a)\geq 4 .

arxiv-2205-15009.title: Carleman Lifting for Nonlinear System Identification with Guaranteed Error Bounds
arxiv-2205-15009.creator: Moad Abudia, Joel A. Rosenfeld, Rushikesh Kamalapurkar
arxiv-2205-15009.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Moad Abudia, Joel A. Rosenfeld, Rushikesh Kamalapurkar. This paper concerns identification of uncontrolled or closed loop nonlinear systems using a set of trajectories that are generated by the system in a domain of attraction. The objective is to ensure that the trajectories of the identified systems are close to the trajectories of the real system, as quantified by an error bound that is prescribed a priori .

arxiv-2207-06490.title: A Robustly Optimized Long Text to Math Models for Numerical Reasoning On FinQA
arxiv-2207-06490.creator: Renhui Zhang, Youwei Zhang, Yao Yu
arxiv-2207-06490.description: Abstract Numerical reasoning is required when solving most problems in our life, but it has been neglected in previous artificial intelligence researches. FinQA challenge has been organized to strengthen the study on numerical reasoning where the participants are asked to predict the numerical reasoning program to solve financial question.

arxiv-2409-09055.title: Generalised 6j symbols over the category of G G -graded vector spaces
arxiv-2409-09055.creator: Fabio Lischka
arxiv-2409-09055.description: Abstract Any choice of a spherical fusion category defines an invariant of oriented closed 3-manifolds, which is computed by choosing a triangulation of the manifold and considering a state sum model that assigns a 6j symbol to every tetrahedron in this triangulation. This approach has been generalized to oriented closed 3-manifolds with defect data by Catherine Meusburger.

arxiv-2412-02274.title: Parallelizing the Computation of Robustness for Measuring the Strength of Tuples
arxiv-2412-02274.creator: Davide Martinenghi
arxiv-2412-02274.description: Abstract Several indicators have been recently proposed for measuring various characteristics of the tuples of a dataset – particularly, the so-called skyline tuples, i.e., those that are not dominated by other tuples. Numeric indicators are very important as they may, e.g., provide an additional criterion to be used to rank skyline tuples and focus on a subset thereof.

arxiv-2501-00527.title: Exploiting Boundary Loss for the Hierarchical Panoptic Segmentation of Plants and Leaves
arxiv-2501-00527.creator: Madeleine Darbyshire, Elizabeth Sklar, Simon Parsons
arxiv-2501-00527.description: Abstract Precision agriculture leverages data and machine learning so that farmers can monitor their crops and target interventions precisely. This enables the precision application of herbicide only to weeds, or the precision application of fertilizer only to undernourished crops, rather than to the entire field.

arxiv-2507-15417.title: 1.64-Approximation for Chromatic Correlation Clustering via Chromatic Cluster LP
arxiv-2507-15417.creator: Dahoon Lee, Chenglin Fan, Euiwoong Lee
arxiv-2507-15417.description: Abstract Chromatic Correlation Clustering (CCC) generalizes Correlation Clustering by assigning multiple categorical relationships (colors) to edges and imposing chromatic constraints on the clusters. Unlike traditional Correlation Clustering, which only deals with binary ( + / − ) (+/-) relationships, CCC captures richer relational structures.

arxiv-2512-02402.title: TaleFrame : An Interactive Story Generation System with Fine-Grained Control and Large Language Models
arxiv-2512-02402.creator: Yunchao Wang, Guodao Sun, Zihang Fu, Zhehao Liu, Kaixing Du, Haidong Gao, Ronghua Liang
arxiv-2512-02402.description: Abstract With the advancement of natural language generation (NLG) technologies, creative story generation systems have gained increasing attention. However, current systems often fail to accurately translate user intent into satisfactory story outputs due to a lack of fine-grained control and unclear input specifications, limiting their applicability.

conrad-set-of-six-1908.description: Conrad's 1908 stories — 'The Brute', 'Gaspar Ruiz', 'The Informer', 'The Duel'; the middle-period tales.

pmc-10622374.title: The ligamentum mucosum’s potential as a preventative structure in the development of knee osteoarthritis
pmc-10622374.creator: Alexandra Martin, Kenneth Liu, Majid Alimohammadi
pmc-10622374.description: PurposeThis paper aimed to identify whether the presence, type, and/or morphology of the ligamentum mucosum could play a role in the development of knee osteoarthritis. Since its microscopic structure is alike that of other knee ligaments, it was hypothesized that its presence could facilitate knee motion and stability, thus preventing or reducing the extent of knee osteoarthritis.

pmc-11432800.title: Flap-Free Tendon Coverage Using Autologous Fat Grafts Enhanced with Platelet-Rich Plasma and Growth Factors at a Secondary Level Hospital: A Case Report
pmc-11432800.creator: Guadalupe Santamaría Salvador, Esteban Acosta Muñoz, Juan Samaniego Rojas, Charles Hidalgo Quishpe, Juan S Izquierdo-Condoy, Jorge Vasconez-Gonzalez, Esteban Ortiz-Prado, Peter Niclas Broer, Denis C Ehrl, Paul Immanuel Heidekrueger
pmc-11432800.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Autologous fat grafting, enriched with platelet-rich plasma (PRP), has been established as an effective and affordable treatment for various types of wound healing. However, its efficacy in managing wounds with tendon exposure has not been thoroughly investigated. Methods: We report the case of a 40-year-old male who sustained a severe friction burn on his hand and forearm from a car accident, resulting in significant tissue loss and exposed extensor tendons.

pmc-11469875.title: Serum levels of total bile acids are associated with an increased risk of HCC in patients with cirrhosis
pmc-11469875.creator: Hashem B. El-Serag, Aaron P. Thrift, Hao Duong, Jing Ning, Saira Khaderi, Amit G. Singal, Sumeet K. Asrani, Jorge A. Marrero, Hannah Powell, Kinza Rizwan, Omar Najjar, Christopher I. Amos, Michelle Luster, Abeer Al-Sarraj, Emad Salem, Michael E. Scheurer, Jagpreet Chhatwal, Salma Kaochar, Fasiha Kan
pmc-11469875.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background:Previous studies have reported higher circulating bile acid levels in patients with HCC compared to healthy controls. However, the association between prediagnostic bile acid levels and HCC risk among patients with cirrhosis is unclear.Methods:We measured total BA (TBA) concentration in serum samples collected from a prospective cohort of patients with cirrhosis who were followed until the development of HCC, death, or last study date.

pmc-11518713.title: Effects of mesenchymal stromal cells and human recombinant Nerve Growth Factor delivered by bioengineered human corneal lenticule on an innovative model of diabetic retinopathy
pmc-11518713.creator: Letizia Pelusi, Jose Hurst, Nicola Detta, Caterina Pipino, Alessia Lamolinara, Gemma Conte, Rodolfo Mastropasqua, Marcello Allegretti, Nadia Di Pietrantonio, Tiziana Romeo, Mona El Zarif, Mario Nubile, Laura Guerricchio, Sveva Bollini, Assunta Pandolfi, Sven Schnichels, Domitilla Mandatori
pmc-11518713.description: IntroductionDiabetic retinopathy (DR) is a microvascular complication of diabetes in which neurodegeneration has been recently identified as a driving force. In the last years, mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs) and neurotrophins like Nerve Growth Factor (NGF), have garnered significant attention as innovative therapeutic approaches targeting DR-associated neurodegeneration. However, delivering neurotrophic factors directly in the eye remains a challenge.

pmc-12622992.title: The impact of donor and recipient age on post-transplantation clonality in murine hematopoiesis
pmc-12622992.creator: Lars Thielecke, Kalpana Nattamai, Aishlin Hassan, Ingmar Glauche, Hartmut Geiger, Kerstin Cornils
pmc-12622992.description: IntroductionThe sustained production of blood and immune cells is driven by a pool of hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) and their offspring. Due to the intrinsic heterogeneity of HSCs, the composition of emergent clones changes over time, leading to a reduced clonality in aging mice and humans.

pmc-13195132.title: Reduced inhibition, bursting, and accelerated oscillations drive early hippocampal hyperactivity in Alzheimer’s disease in vivo
pmc-13195132.creator: Soraya Meftah, Sungmin Kang, Mingshan Liu, Xingran Wang, Ada Nursel Topçu, Maialen Martin Abad, Áron Kőszeghy, Long Wan, Conor Mullin, Lida Zoupi, Jian Gan
pmc-13195132.description: ‘Early hippocampal hyperactivity’ is well-documented in Alzheimer’s disease (AD), yet its mechanisms in vivo before amyloid-β plaque deposition at the levels of synaptic transmission and neural oscillations remain unclear. Here, we perform in vivo high-resolution patch-clamp and high-throughput probe recordings in the hippocampus of amyloidopathy mice before plaque deposition.

pmc-13300828.title: Platelet Indices and Adipokines in Adults with Long-Standing Type 1 Diabetes
pmc-13300828.creator: Gergana Chausheva, Sevim Shefket, Yana Bocheva, Kaloyan Tsochev, Tatiana Chalakova, Natalya Usheva, Yoto Yotov, Violeta Iotova
pmc-13300828.description: Background: Type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1D) is associated with chronic inflammation, platelet-related alterations, and increased cardiovascular risk (CVR). The relationships between adipokines and platelet indices in long-standing T1D remain incompletely defined. Objective: To explore the relationships between adipokines (adiponectin and leptin), platelet indices, and inflammatory status in adults with long-standing T1D.

pmc-13363849.title: Chlorophyll b—An Essence of Plant Photosynthesis
pmc-13363849.creator: John Kenneth Hoober, Laura L. Eggink, Daniel-Paul Bednarik, Steffen Reinbothe

pmc-13374320.title: Women’s postpartum adjustment questionnaire (WPPAQ): development and psychometric evaluation in an exploratory sequential mixed methods study
pmc-13374320.creator: Mahboobeh Asadi, Mahnaz Noroozi, Mousa Alavi
pmc-13374320.description: BackgroundPostpartum women experience a range of physical, psychological, and social changes. Identifying and helping maladjusted women requires a comprehensive and efficient questionnaire. This mixed methods study aimed to examine the psychometric properties of the women’s postpartum adjustment questionnaire (WPPAQ) across a sample of Iranian postnatal women.

pmc-13392409.title: Dirofilaria immitis Causing Flexor Tenosynovitis of the Hand: A Rare Case Report
pmc-13392409.creator: Jamie C. Henzes, John T. Rich
pmc-13392409.description: This case describes a previously underreported case of flexor tenosynovitis. A 23‐year‐old male slaughterhouse employee presented with several weeks of increased pain and swelling in their left third digit. They failed nonoperative management, including anti‐inflammatory medication and oral steroids, followed by corticosteroid injection. Intraoperative pathology demonstrated subacute flexor tenosynovitis due to a rare parasitic infection of Dirofilaria immitis.

pmc-13452329.title: Return to School After Posterior Spinal Fusion in Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis: A Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-13452329.creator: Anne Boeckmann, Erica Olfson, David Thornberg, Chan-Hee Jo, Megan Johnson, Amy L. McIntosh
pmc-13452329.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPosterior spinal fusion (PSF) is the standard surgical treatment for progressive adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS). While return to sport after PSF has been described, return to school (RTS) remains poorly defined despite its educational and psychosocial importance. This study aimed to quantify RTS timelines, compare anticipated versus observed absences, and evaluate demographic, surgical, psychosocial, and socioeconomic predictorsMethodsConsecutively enrolled English-speaking AIS and juvenile idiopathic scoliosis (JIS) patients undergoing PSF at a single institution between 2022 and 2025 were prospectively studied.

pmc-13572184.title: Comparative evaluation of different chilling methods on carcass and meat quality traits of pigeons
pmc-13572184.creator: Shraboni Jhora Badhan, Most. Mustary Mahbub, Shuoshuo Lv, Jannatul Fardous Juthi, Md. Siam Ul Bari, Md. Mushfiquer Rahman Raihan, Hasan Mohammad Murshed, Shuangshuang Guo, Zhengfan Zhang, Md. Abul Kalam Azad
pmc-13572184.description: This study evaluated the effect of different chilling methods on carcass traits, physicochemical properties, and sensory attributes of indigenous pigeon (Columba livia domestica) carcasses. Two hundred pigeon’s carcass was assigned to four treatment groups: no chilling (control), iced water chilling (30 min), and conventional chilling (3 h and 24 h) at 4°C.
